September's vLLM 0.30.0 runs repeated tokens under strict JSON; those results retain their original configuration. Compatibility of this configuration must be checked with --quick before a full run.

  CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

  SUM(t1.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t2 ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t2.DT_K

answers.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT t1.LN_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS AS t1
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t2
    ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t2.DT_K
WHERE
  t2.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND t1.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH BranchCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.RGN_CD1,
        b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) DESC) as rank
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT 
    RGN_CD1,
    branch_name,
    transaction_count
FROM BranchCounts
WHERE rank = 1;

SELECT t2.ISO_ALPH_CD1,
  SUM(t1.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY t2
  ON t1.CCY_K = t2.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t2.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
  COUNT(t1.WR_TRF_F_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS t1
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t2 ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t2.DT_K
WHERE
  t2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT b.DSPLY_NM, AVG(c.ANNL_INCM_AMT) AS avg_salary FROM bank_dwh.D_BR b JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON 1=0 GROUP BY b.DSPLY_NM;
